extracted.intended_audience: patent attorneys, patent agents, IP teams, and IP practice managers evaluating or selecting patent drafting/prosecution software
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and product-driven standards for preparing, reviewing, and prosecuting patent applications using an integrated, AI-enabled drafting solution that synchronizes specification, claims, and drawings to improve quality, consistency and efficiency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Synchronization of application components
rubrics_metrics.description: Connects and synchronizes every element of a patent application — specification, claims, figures, chemical structures and biological sequences — so that changes are reflected across the whole application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure part references, terminology and numbering are automatically synchronized across specification, claims and drawings to maintain consistency and reduce errors. Rowan positions this as fundamental to improving quality and compliance with drafting requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality and consistency across drafts and jurisdictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure patent quality, consistency and compliance with technology- and jurisdiction-specific components and templates (including U.S. and European requirements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use pre-configured templates and a drafting library to accelerate drafting and to ensure compliance with client guidelines and jurisdictional drafting requirements. The product emphasizes real-time, rules-based validation to support these goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Real-time, rules-based validation and error checking
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide real-time validation, error checking and consistency review while drafting to surface issues early.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage automated checks (rules-based) throughout drafting to identify problems that could lead to rejections during examination, supporting more accurate first filings and amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Terminology and terms management
rubrics_metrics.description: Import, define and manage key concepts and terminology consistently throughout the application leveraging a Terms Manager feature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain consistent usage of defined terms across claims, specification, and figures to avoid inconsistency-related examination problems and improve readability and legal robustness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Antecedent basis and claim support checking
rubrics_metrics.description: Analyze drafts to check for antecedent basis errors and whether claims are supported by the specification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automatically flag antecedent basis problems and missing claim support so drafters can correct specification language or claim wording before filing or amendment, reducing §112/112 rejections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Predictive NLP for prosecution risk and classification
rubrics_metrics.description: Use Natural Language Processing optimized for patent language to predict art units, potential 112 issues, drawing parts lists, claim trees and other prosecution-related analytics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage predictive analytics to anticipate examination risks and to prioritize drafting or amendment work; use predictions to inform prosecution strategy and reduce office actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automated part numbering and integrated drawing tool
rubrics_metrics.description: Built-in drawing tool designed for patent application drawings with numbering synchronized with other parts of the application and automatic part numbering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create figures and part references that automatically synchronize with claims and specification to avoid mismatches between drawings and text and to streamline figure creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Templates and drafting library for compliance and reuse
rubrics_metrics.description: Pre-configured templates and a Drafting Library to accelerate drafting, ensure compliance with client guidelines and support reuse of material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use configurable templates and libraries to standardize outputs, reduce repetitive drafting tasks, and help junior practitioners follow firm/client drafting standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automated Office action response generation
rubrics_metrics.description: Automate shell package generation for Office action responses, including identifying examiner rejections and cited prior art to inform response strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generate response shells and accelerate preparation using automation and a library of boilerplate text inserts; combine with interactive tools (Rejection Navigator) to develop strategy and track issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claim amendment synchronization and validation
rubrics_metrics.description: Automate amendments with USPTO markup styling, claim status rollover, claim status inserts and automatic synchronization of amendments to parallel claim elements, and validate that amendments are supported in the specification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When amending claims, ensure the system synchronizes changes across dependent claims, maintains formatting consistent with office expectations, and verifies that amended claim language has basis in the specification to reduce examination risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain practitioner control over AI outputs
rubrics_metrics.description: Task-based, AI-assisted tools enable control over inputs while managing generated outputs so practitioners retain full control of the drafting process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target sections appropriate for AI generation (e.g., summary, abstract, flowcharts, claim transformations), review and edit generated content, and tailor AI capabilities to organizational and practitioner preferences for responsible use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technology-specific support (chemistry & biotechnology)
rubrics_metrics.description: Unique support for chemistry and biotechnology drafting needs, including compound and sequence management and an integrated chemical structure tool.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use specialized tools for compound and sequence handling to ensure correct representation and linkage across specification, claims and figures in life-science/chemistry applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consistency analysis across drafts, publications, and amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: Review analyzes consistency of terms in draft applications, published applications, and amended claims for error checking and predictive analysis to improve prosecution outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare multiple document states (drafts, published apps, amended claims) to find inconsistencies that could harm prosecution or enforcement; use findings to correct the corpus before filing or submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Efficiency and measurable prosecution outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of the tool should deliver productivity gains and reduced office actions (claims cited: 36% average productivity gain, 18% reduction in number of Office Actions, 44% fewer 112 rejections, 5x faster to prepare Office Action response shells).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track quantitative KPIs (productivity, office action rates, time-to-response) to evaluate ROI of adopting the drafting/prosecution platform; use metrics to validate quality and process improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Draft generation and claim transformation capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Embedded, task-based GenAI assistants and AI chat with intelligent prompt assistance to generate and manage sections of draft applications such as summary, abstract, flowchart generation and claim transformations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Employ AI to draft routine or structured sections and to perform claim transformations, but review generated outputs for legal sufficiency and alignment with strategy; use prompt assistance to guide AI toward jurisdictional and client-specific norms.
